Sen. Chris Coons hospitalized after collision in Sussex County
sources.text:
Sen. Chris Coons hospitalized after collision in Sussex County
- Sen. Chris Coons was a passenger in a car involved in a multi-vehicle crash. He was hospitalized with minor injuries.
- His office said he is home and expected to make a "full and swift recovery."
- The driver who caused the collision was having a "medical incident," Coons' office said.
Sen. Chris Coons was taken to the hospital with minor injuries after a crash in Sussex County, his office announced. He is home and expected to make a "full and swift recovery."
His office said Coons was a passenger in a vehicle in Sussex County, when a driver having a "medical incident" collided with several cars, including his. The collision occurred on Savannah Road in Lewes.
Coons was transported to Beebe Hospital in Lewes and treated for minor injuries. No one was seriously injured. Coons thanked Lewes and Rehoboth Beach Fire Company, Lewes Police, Sussex County EMS and Beebe doctors and staff.
Who is Chris Coons?
Coons, a Democratic Senator, was elected to his current position in 2010. He is the state's senior Senator and the longest-serving member of Delaware's current federal delegation. He is also the Vice Chair of the Senate Ethics Committee, and he was the Chair of it previously.
Before his tenure in Washington, D.C., he was the New Castle County President and the New Castle County Executive.
